entities.name: Władysław Gurowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Władysław Gurowski was a noble of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Chamberlain of Polish king Augustus III of Poland from 1758; Great Crown Clerk from 1764; Court Lithuanian Marshal from 1768; Great Lithuanian Marshal from 1781.
